ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels on visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black contiguous regions across both lobes; focal high-intensity white mottling at the central fluke-peduncle intersection; distinct horizontal high-intensity white band on the right lobe medial section; high-intensity white clusters at both distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15 percent of the total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitudes vary from 5 to 20 pixels; more pronounced jagged peaks localized on the right lobe distal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concavity along the trailing edges of both lobes curving towards the tips; leading edges show slight convexity at the visible distal sections.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips and along trailing edge margins, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned white linear streaks visible on the dark medial region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation and jagged tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct bifurcated white geometric marking at the fluke-peduncle intersection point.
